status_definitions.MEASURED: all 100 pairs measured in both languages; every guard held on all 200 texts
status_definitions.EQUIVALENT: token ids identical to another tokenizer's on all 200 texts; reported only as a member of that tokenizer's group, never as an independent result
status_definitions.EXCLUDED: at least one corpus text cannot be represented faithfully; no value published
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: no public tokenizer could be verified; nothing substituted
status_definitions.BLOCKED: the pinned assets could not be obtained or loaded; no value published

asset_policy: allow-listed tokenizer files only (tokenizer.json, tokenizer.model, tokenizer_config.json) at pinned revisions, SHA-256 checked before use; no weights; no repository code run

official_crosscheck.allam: token ids identical to the official sentencepiece 0.2.1 SentencePieceProcessor.encode on all 200 corpus texts and 15 synthetic edge cases (leading digits, Arabic-Indic digits, repeated, leading and trailing spaces, byte-fallback characters); run in an isolated environment, not a dependency
official_crosscheck.fanar_2: tokenizer.json ids identical to the official sentencepiece 0.2.1 encoding with the repository's own tokenizer.model on the same 215 texts
official_crosscheck.others: tokenizer.json is the released artifact and `tokenizers` its declared runtime

allam-7b-instruct-preview.developers: National Center for Artificial Intelligence (NCAI), Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA); repository now hosted by the humain-ai organization
allam-7b-instruct-preview.license: apache-2.0 (Hub metadata; the model card refers to a LICENSE file that is not in the repository)
allam-7b-instruct-preview.source_note: The repository ships only a SentencePiece tokenizer.model (no tokenizer.json at any of its 33 commits); this revision is the 'version 2' tokenizer. It is a BPE model (64,000 pieces, identity normalization, byte fallback, dummy prefix, digits as user-defined symbols). ATTI reads the model file with a standard-library protobuf reader and encodes in SentencePiece order (normalize once, split user-defined symbols, BPE with byte fallback). tokenizer_config.json: add_bos_token=false, add_eos_token=false.

checks.guards: no truncation/overflow; every character covered; no special or unknown ids; decode round-trip; identical ids on repeat

jais-3-375b-a23b.developers: Team IFM (Institute of Foundation Models, MBZUAI) per the model card citation; repository hosted by the inception42 organization
jais-3-375b-a23b.source_note: Released tokenizer.json (byte-level BPE, 250,000 base tokens + 624 added; NFC normalizer; the TemplateProcessing post-processor adds a begin-of-text token only when special tokens are requested, which content-only counts never do). tokenizer_class PreTrainedTokenizerFast; the repository's custom code is model configuration only and is not used.

checks.guards: no truncation/overflow; every character covered; no special or unknown ids; decode round-trip; identical ids on repeat
checks.round_trip: exact up to the tokenizer's own NFC normalization (4 texts change)

fanar-2-27b-instruct.developers: Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI), Hamad Bin Khalifa University; sponsored by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, State of Qatar. Tokenizer: Google (Gemma 3), unchanged
fanar-2-27b-instruct.source_note: Continually pretrained from google/gemma-3-27b-pt. Its tokenizer.json has the same SHA-256 as google/gemma-3-27b-it@005ad3404e59d6023443cb575daa05336842228a, and its tokenizer.model (SHA-256 1299c11d7cf632ef3b4e11937501358ada021bbdf7c47638d13c0ee982f2e79c) equals that of gemma-3-27b-pt@9fe3c4ebc93fbadb14913801536d022054ef11cc and gemma-3-27b-it (Hub file metadata; the Gemma repositories are gated and were not downloaded). The tokenizer is therefore Google's Gemma 3 tokenizer, unchanged. SentencePiece-style BPE with byte fallback; the post-processor's <bos> is added only on request.

checks.guards: no truncation/overflow; every character covered; no special or unknown ids; decode round-trip; identical ids on repeat

aragpt2-mega.developers: AUB MIND Lab, American University of Beirut
aragpt2-mega.source_note: Released tokenizer.json (GPT-2 byte-level BPE, 64,000 tokens, add_prefix_space=true; no tokenizer_config.json in the repository). The model card asks that input first be passed through the arabert ArabertPreprocessor; ATTI applies no preprocessing beyond its whitespace normalization, so counts are for the text as published. The repository's custom code is model code only and is not used.

checks.guards: no truncation/overflow; every character covered; no special or unknown ids; decode round-trip; identical ids on repeat
checks.round_trip: exact up to the GPT-2 prefix space the tokenizer adds

falcon-h1-arabic.reason: No public tokenizer: no Falcon-H1 Arabic repository exists on the Hugging Face Hub (searches for Falcon-H1-Arabic, Falcon-Arabic and falcon-h1-ar, by author tiiuae and Hub-wide), and the official announcement (huggingface.co/blog/tiiuae/falcon-h1-arabic) and product page (falconllm.tii.ae/falcon-h1-arabic.html) link only a chat interface. Neither states that it uses the standard Falcon-H1 tokenizer, so that tokenizer is not substituted.
